[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended recipes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Kansas City-Style BBQ Sauce: Uses tomato paste, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Smoky BBQ Sauce: Uses chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, apple cider vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Carolina-Style Vinegar BBQ Sauce: Uses apple cider vinegar, water, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Sweet and Spicy BBQ Sauce: Uses brown sugar, hot sauce, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested adjustments to reduce sweetness:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Reduce sugar content by 1/4 to 1/2 cup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Add more acidity with vinegar or lemon juice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Use different sweeteners like honey or maple syrup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Add more spices like paprika, garlic powder, or onion powder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] BBQ sauce is about balance and personal preference.
